**Project environments** — the named ex
ecution bundles (one host, optionally a\nstandalone server group, optionally pinned skills and plugin versions) that eval\nsuites
and goals run against. Reads need project membership; **every write\nneeds project admin**. Writes are revisioned: pass the `revis
ion` you last read\nback as `expectedRevision`, and a stale value returns `CONFLICT` (409) instead\nof overwriting a concurrent ed

it.

| Endpoint | What it does |
| - | - |
| `GET`, `POST /projects/{projectId}/environments` | List environments (`?includeAr
chived=true` to include archived ones), or create one |\n| `GET`, `PATCH /projects/{projectId}/environments/{environmentId}` | Rea
d one environment, or edit it (send `null` to clear `serverAttachmentId`, `skillSelection`, or `pluginVersionIds`) |\n| `GET /proj
ects/{projectId}/environments/{environmentId}/resolve` | Preview the host config, closed server set, and pinned plugin versions th
is environment resolves to right now |\n| `POST /projects/{projectId}/environments/{environmentId}/archive` | Archive it — reversi
ble, and frees the name for a new one |\n| `POST /projects/{projectId}/environments/{environmentId}/restore` | Restore an archived

environment |

Archive and restore are explicit sub-actions rather than a `DELETE` because the
row is kept and restore has rea

l semantics: it re-checks the name and drops
plugin pins whose version no longer exists.

**Server diagnostics & primitives** (

`/projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/...`):

| Endpoint | What it does |
| - | - |
| `POST .../validate` | Connect, initi
alize, and capture a capability snapshot |\n| `POST .../doctor` | Full health workflow: probe → connect → initialize → capabilitie

s |
| `POST .../check-oauth` | Does this server require an OAuth grant? |
| `POST .../tools` | List the server's tools |
| `POS
T .../tools/call` | Execute a tool; returns the MCP `CallToolResult` plus additive `durationMs`, and `authChallenge` when the resu
lt asks for sign-in (see [Sign-in challenges](#sign-in-challenges)) |\n| `POST .../prompts` | List the server's prompts |\n| `POST
.../prompts/get` | Render a prompt; returns the MCP `GetPromptResult` verbatim |\n| `POST .../resources` | List the server's reso
urces |\n| `POST .../resources/read` | Read one resource by URI |\n| `POST .../export` | One JSON snapshot of tools, resources, an
d prompts |\n| `GET`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE .../accounts[/{account}]` | The server's accounts. See [Server accounts](#server-acc
ounts) |\n| `POST .../oauth/import-tokens` | **Deprecated.** Uploads to your default account; use `PUT .../accounts/{account}`. Se

e [The deprecated import route](#the-deprecated-import-route) |

**Eval runs** (`/projects/{projectId}/...`):

| Endpoint | Wh
at it does |\n| - | - |\n| `POST .../eval-suites` | Author-only: create a suite + its test cases from `name` + `serverIds` + a def
ault `model` + `tests`, WITHOUT running it; responds `201` + `suiteId`. Each test's case body is an ordered `steps` array (prompt
/ toolCall / interact / assert); per-test `model`/`provider`/`runs` are optional and fall back to suite defaults |\n| `POST .../ev
al-runs` | Create a run from a `suiteId` (rerun; `serverIds` optional — defaults to the suite's saved servers) or `suiteName` + in
line `tests` + `serverIds` (new suite). `environmentId` (requires `suiteId`) runs against one of the suite's attached environments
instead. Responds `202` + `runId` |\n| `PATCH .../eval-suites/{suiteId}` | Edit suite settings, including `environmentIds` — the
project environments the suite runs against (non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears) |\n| `PATCH .../eval-suites/{suiteId}/s
chedule` | Enable/disable scheduled runs; `environmentId` pins which environment they launch |\n| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}` | Ru
n status, result, and summary — poll until terminal. Carries `gateWaiver`: the audited override in force over this run's gate, or
`null` |\n| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate` | The stored suite quality-gate report for this run (`passed` / `failed` / `non_gatea
ble` / `not_configured`). `not_configured` is a 200 report, never a missing route. A deployment that predates the evaluator answer
s `422 FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED` |\n| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/decision-summary` | **Start here when a run did not pass.** The cano
nical run decision contract: the verdict and where it came from, counts labelled with the population they count, the run's own ver
dict decision, and per-trial diagnostics with the user-value chain, the first failed stage, the failure category, evidence scoped
to that stage, and one next action (paginated) |\n| `POST .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate-waivers` | Override a **failing** run's relea
se gate until `expiresAt` (required, future, max 30 days out), with a `reason` (required, max 500 chars). Manage tier. Does NOT ch
ange the run's `result` — the run keeps its verdict and the waiver is reported alongside it. `409` when one is already in force, r
eturning the existing waiver |\n| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate-waivers` | The waiver in force over a run, or `null`. Readable b
y anyone who can view the run |\n| `DELETE .../eval-runs/{runId}/gate-waivers/{waiverId}` | Revoke a waiver, putting the gate back
. Idempotent — a second call reports the original revocation rather than restamping it |\n| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/iterations`
| Per-iteration results: tool calls, token usage, latency (paginated) |\n| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/iterations/{iterationId}/tr
ace` | Full trace: messages + expected-vs-actual analysis |\n| `GET .../eval-suites/{suiteId}/runs` | Recent runs for a suite, new
est first |\n\n**Eval result ingestion** (`/projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/...`) — how `@mcpjam/sdk` saves results from eval run
s executed outside the platform (local dev, CI). The `{projectId}` segment accepts the literal `default` for the key org's Default
project. Most users never call these directly — set `MCPJAM_API_KEY` and the [SDK reporter](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/

saving-results.md) does:

| Endpoint | What it does |
| - | - |
| `POST .../eval-ingest/report` | One-shot: create a run from
finished results and finalize it |\n| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/start` | Chunked flow: create (or idempotently reuse) a run by `e
xternalRunId` |\n| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/iterations` | Append an iteration batch to a started run |\n| `POST .../eval-ingest/
runs/finalize` | Finalize a chunked run (idempotent) |\n| `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts` | Store one artifact's raw bytes (widge
t HTML too large to send inline) and return its `storageId` |\n| `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts/upload-url` | Retired. Answers `4
10 Gone` with `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload artifacts with `POST .../eval-ingest

/artifacts` instead |

**Agent** (`/projects/{projectId}/agent`) — a headless assistant turn for
building conversational surfac

es (the MCPJam Slack app is the first consumer):

| Endpoint | What it does |
| - | - |
| `POST .../agent` | Run ONE assistant
turn over a `messages` history (`{role: \"user\"\\|\"assistant\", content}` items, max 50 messages × 8 KB each, 96 KB total). The
model is pinned server-side and billed to the project. The turn can read project servers/suites/runs and **create eval suites**;
it can NOT start runs — kick those off yourself with `POST .../eval-runs`. Responds synchronously with `reply`, the `toolCalls` it
made, `createdResources` (ids + app links), and token `usage`. Capped at 4 concurrent turns per organization and \\~90 s wall clo
ck. **Not idempotent — never blind-retry**: dedupe on your own trigger identity, and on an error response check `details.createdRe
sources` (and, after a lost response, list suites) before retrying, or you'll create duplicates |\n\n**Studies** (`/projects/{proj

ectId}/studies...`):

| Endpoint | What it does |
| - | - |
| `GET .../studies` | List the project's published studies: name,
